'''Devton Cirrilla''' was the a member of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] who operated in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. Using the alias '''Carill Benton''' he served as the chief executive officer of [[Data Equity Management, Inc.]]<ref name="LOTE" />
